395:t_4:18.en:
$$ガロード$$
(This could be... my chance...!)

395:t_4:26.en:
$$ティファ$$
(This feeling... Who are you...?)

395:t_2:3.en:
$$エイミー$$
「It's been so long that I was worried I couldn't dance properly... How was it, $$レド$$?」

395:t_2:5.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Thank you. I guess my body remembered after all.」

395:t_2:8.en:
$$レド$$
「I want to see... you dance, $$エイミー$$.」

395:t_2:9.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Okay...! Then I'll dance for you, $$レド$$.」

395:t_2:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have detected an enemy. Interception is required.」

395:t_2:13.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I have finished analyzing its unique signature. The probability is 99.97%...」

395:t_2:14.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I identify the target as $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

395:t_3:3.en: ～$$マクロス・クォーター$$　Hangar～

395:t_3:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「He's with Captain $$ジェフリー$$ at the Fleet Commander's room, explaining what happened.」

395:t_3:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「If the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ really have come to Earth, that will be troublesome.」

395:t_3:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「But the creature Ensign $$レド$$ killed is called a $$クジライカ$$ by the fleet. It existed before the transfer.」

395:t_3:8.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Then the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ were in the $$残されの海$$ before it transferred to $$翠の地球$$?」

395:t_3:9.en:
$$ルカ$$
「That also suggests that Ensign $$レド$$'s $$人類銀河同盟$$ and the $$残されの海$$ come from the same world.」

395:t_3:10.en:
$n
「So they were sent to the center of the galaxy and its outskirts, respectively...」

395:t_3:12.en:
$$アルト$$
「You mean the operation to find the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$ nest and wipe them out...」

395:t_3:13.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But those $$クジライカ$$ are like emissaries of God to the people in the fleet.」

395:t_3:14.en:
$$ロラン$$
「And apparently they're harmless as long as we don't attack them.」

395:t_3:15.en:
$$ロラン$$
「To go out of our way to exterminate them would be...」

395:t_3:16.en:
$$宗介$$
「But according to $$チェインバー#pilot$$'s analysis, it's certain that the $$クジライカ$$ are a type of $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

395:t_3:17.en:
$$アルト$$
「We experienced just how terrifying they are when we were sent to the galactic center.」

395:t_3:18.en:
$n
「Strike before you're struck... $$レド$$'s proposal does make some sense...」

395:t_3:21.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then try communicating with them through your song. If you cannot, they will be classified as $$バアル$$.」

395:t_3:24.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Of course. They'd hate being labeled $$バアル$$ without anyone even asking them.」

395:t_3:25.en:
$$アルト$$
「Do you think they have hearts and wills of their own?」

395:t_3:26.en:
$$バサラ$$
「How can you reach a conclusion without even trying?」

395:t_3:27.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we may not have time to wait. $$サイデリアル$$'s activities in the $$残されの海$$ probably involve investigating the $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

395:t_3:28.en:
$$ガロード$$
「They're fighting $$バアル$$, after all.」

395:t_3:29.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Then I'll let them hear my song before that happens.」

395:t_3:32.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「This concerns the $$ガルガンティア船団$$'s culture, too. As long as the $$クジライカ$$ don't attack us, we have no right to decide.」

395:t_3:33.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I agree with Captain $$ガムリン$$. Let's hear what the people in the fleet think first.」

395:t_3:34.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I wonder what $$レド$$ is talking about right now...」

395:t_3:38.en: ～$$ガルガンティア船団$$　Fleet Commander's Room～

395:t_3:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「...We will take our leave, then.」

395:t_3:41.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「...Does everyone understand the situation?」

395:t_3:42.en:
$$リジット$$
「How could he...? I warned them so clearly not to harm the $$クジライカ$$...」

395:t_3:43.en:
$$フランジ$$
「Unrest is already spreading among the residents.」

395:t_3:44.en:
$$クラウン$$
「There are even rumors that we will be cursed.」

395:t_3:45.en:
$$リジット$$
「We can't just dismiss this as superstition.」

395:t_3:46.en:
$$クラウン$$
「Sailors hold such beliefs dear. Now that their greatest taboo has been broken, this is a natural response.」

395:t_3:47.en:
$$オルダム$$
「But as Captain $$ジェフリー$$ reported, we must not forget that the $$クジライカ$$ are the same as what $$レド$$ calls $$ヒディアーズ#robot$$.」

395:t_3:48.en:
$$リジット$$
「So you approve of what he did?」

395:t_3:49.en:
$$オルダム$$
「No. What matters is discussing what to do next, rather than blaming people for what has already happened.」

395:t_3:51.en:
$$フランジ$$
「On that matter, Fleet Commander... I'd like to take this opportunity to hear your answer to my earlier proposal.」

395:t_3:53.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I would like permission to separate my ships from $$ガルガンティア$$ and act independently.」

395:t_3:54.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「Do you intend to surrender to $$サイデリアル$$?」

395:t_3:55.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I am not that foolish. That is precisely why I intend to acquire enough power to oppose them.」

395:t_3:56.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I will go to the $$霧の海$$.」

395:t_3:57.en:
$$リジット$$
「If a major shipowner like you leaves us now, the fleet's defensive strength will plummet...!」

395:t_3:58.en:
$$フランジ$$
「I reached this decision after careful consideration. Please do not hold it against me.」

395:t_3:60.en:
$$フェアロック$$
「I will not permit it... To endanger all of $$ガルガンティア$$ for the selfish desires of a few... abso... lute... ly...」

395:t_3:63.en:
$$オルダム$$
「This is bad...! He's having an attack!」
